Package index

Package overview

IsoriX-package IsoriX
Isoscape Computation and Inference of Spatial Origins using Mixed Models

Preparing the data

prepsources()
Filter and aggregate the raw source dataset
prepraster()
Prepare the structural raster
prepcipitate()
Prepare the raster brick containing the precipitation data
getelev()
Download an elevation raster from internet
getprecip()
Download rasters of monthly precipitation from internet
downloadfile()
Download files and check their binary integrity
create_aliens()
Simulate datasets for calibrations or assignments

Building isoscapes

isofit()
Fit the isoscape models
isomultifit()
Fit isoscape models per strata (typically time interval such as months)
isoscape()
Predicts the spatial distribution of source isotopic values
isomultiscape()
Predicts the average spatial distribution of isotopic values over months, years...
AIC(<ISOFIT>)
Compute the conditional AIC of fitted isoscapes

Calibration

calibfit()
Fit the calibration model (or load parameters from calibration done outside IsoriX)
calibscape()
Builds calibrated isoscapes, i.e. isoscapes of samples (e.g. tissues)

Assignment

isofind()
Infer spatial origins

Plotting

points(<CALIBFIT>) plot()
Plotting functions for IsoriX
plot_sources()
Map the aggregated source data
plot_dependencies()
Plot the dependencies of IsoriX
isopalette2 isopalette1
Plotting: colour palettes for isoscapes and assignments

Datasets

AssignDataAlien
Assignment data: simulated hydrogen delta values
AssignDataBat AssignDataBatRev
Assignment data: hydrogen delta values of common noctule bats (Voigt & Lehnert 2019)
AssignDataBat2 AssignDataBat2Rev
Assignment data: hydrogen delta values of Myotis bats (Voigt, Lehmann & Greif 2015)
CalibDataAlien
Calibration data: simulated hydrogen delta values
CalibDataBat CalibDataBatRev
Calibration data: hydrogen delta values of sedentary bats (Voigt & Lehnert 2019)
CalibDataBat2 CalibDataBat2Rev
Calibration data: hydrogen delta values of sedentary bats (Popa-Lisseanu et al. 2012)
GNIPDataDE
Source data: hydrogen delta values in precipitation water in Germany
GNIPDataEUagg GNIPDataALLagg
Source data: hydrogen delta values in precipitation water in Europe and in the world (aggregated per location)
CountryBorders
Polygon data: borders of world countries
OceanMask
Polygon data: mask of world oceans
ElevRasterDE
Raster data: elevation in Germany
PrecipBrickDE
Raster data: monthly precipitation amounts in Germany
